privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: This site is a personal recipe notebook. There are no ads, no trackers and no audience measurement, and nothing is passed to a third party. This page describes exactly what is recorded, when, and why.
privacy.nothingTitle: What this site does not do
privacy.nothingAnalytics: No audience measurement: no Google Analytics, no Matomo, nothing equivalent. Visits are not counted.
privacy.nothingAds: No advertising, no profiling, and no sale or sharing of data.
privacy.nothingWidgets: No social network widgets. The share buttons are plain links: nothing is loaded from Facebook, X, Pinterest or WhatsApp unless you click.
privacy.nothingFonts: Typefaces are hosted here rather than on a CDN, so your IP address is not disclosed to Google when the page loads.
privacy.readingBody: Nothing is recorded and no cookie is set. For as long as you are only reading, this site knows nothing about you.
privacy.ratingTitle: Rating a recipe or reacting to it
privacy.ratingCookie: On your first vote, and not before, a “bah-visitor” cookie is set. It holds a random identifier unrelated to who you are and lasts a year. It does one thing: keep your rating yours, so the same person does not rate the same recipe twice.
privacy.ratingFingerprint: A cookie is one keystroke away from being cleared. To limit ballot stuffing, a fingerprint is derived from your IP address and your browser (HMAC-SHA256 under a secret key). The IP address itself is never stored, the fingerprint cannot be reversed, and nobody can recompute it without the key.
privacy.ratingConsent: This cookie is strictly functional: it does not follow you from site to site and serves no measurement. That is why this site shows no consent banner — it has nothing to ask you to accept.
privacy.commentIdentity: Commenting requires signing in with a provider. What is then recorded is your display name, your email address, your account identifier at that provider, and the address of your profile picture.
privacy.commentEmail: The email address is used to recognise your account between visits and to check whether it belongs to a site administrator. It is never shown publicly and is never used to write to you.
privacy.commentPublic: Publicly visible: your display name, the avatar you chose and the text of your comment.
privacy.commentAvatar: No picture is taken from your provider. Your avatar is one you pick here from a fixed set, stored as a short code and drawn by this site, so displaying it contacts nobody.
privacy.commentCookies: Two cookies come with a session. “SESSION” keeps you signed in for thirty days and cannot be read by the page's own code. “XSRF-TOKEN” protects what you submit against requests forged from another site.
privacy.videoBody: No request reaches YouTube until you press play: the image shown beforehand is hosted here. On click the player is loaded from youtube-nocookie.com, and Google's terms apply from that point on.
privacy.localBody: The light or dark theme and the language you pick are kept in your browser, under “bah-organic-theme” and “bah-locale”. They are never sent to the server.
privacy.storageBody: Everything is stored in a single database, on the server hosting this site. The host is named in the legal notice. Nothing is copied elsewhere and no subcontractor has access to it.
privacy.storageRetention: Ratings and reactions are kept for as long as the recipe exists. Comments are kept until you delete them.
privacy.rightsBody: You can delete your own comments, from the recipe you posted them on. Clearing your browser cookies is enough to detach any rating already given from you.
privacy.rightsContact: For access, correction or erasure requests, write to the address given in the legal notice.
